visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair styled in a bun with white bows is seen holding a large bouquet of white flowers. She is wearing a white strapless dress and has stickers on her cheeks. The background is a dense arrangement of pink and red roses under soft studio lighting. (2) The camera cuts to a wide shot of a large, tiered pink structure draped in fabric to resemble a giant cake, decorated with cascading flowers. It stands in a room with high, arched windows. (3) A close-up displays vibrant pink and deep red roses in sharp detail, showing their textures and petals. (4) The woman reappears, now in a short white puff dress with floral accents at the hem, posing playfully in front of the pink tiered structure. (5) Multiple fast cuts show the woman in various poses—leaning against the fabric, smiling at the camera, and touching her face. Her shoulder tattoos are visible as she interacts with the set. (6) A transition shows a new set with white fabric drapes, oversized silver bows, and a tall giraffe statue. The woman is now wearing a shimmering silver/grey glittery dress with a high leg slit. (7) She poses elegantly in the white set, looking into the camera with a confident expression. The lighting is bright and clean, emphasizing the sparkle of her dress. (8) The woman is seen sitting on a platform within the white set, holding the white bouquet again. (9) The scene returns to the pink draped set where the woman waves happily and strikes more cute poses for the camera. (10) Final shots show her sitting on the giant pink structure before the screen fades to black with a white text logo centered on the screen.
